in_marathi.name: Jagavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Speech
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jagati (Universe) + Vacha (Speech) = Jagavi. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is associated with the goddess of speech in Hindu mythology. Jagavi is believed to inspire eloquence, creativity, and effective communication.
